decisionSource: Paula direct instruction in CXOrbia Recovery Project
decision: Current test certification banks must be withdrawable and a new certification bank must be creatable. Apply transversally by project, period, bank and role; no special cases for shoppers.
historicalPolicy: Historical real-person evidence and genuinely earned attempts are not automatically test data, even when DEV bank fixtures are tests. Never bulk delete them by inference.

uiActionsObserved: Importar banco: name, gate, JSON/CSV/text, save pending_review
Crear banco con IA: name, source text/file, question count, gate
Requisito y % mínimo: Retirar banco (confirmation then provider ACK)

sourceFindings.retireBehavior: Status deleted and bank estado withdrawn with committed receipt, actor, exact version, remote readback; historical attempts intentionally unchanged.
sourceFindings.createBehavior: Manual import/AI generation creates pending_review bank requiring review; distinct bank identity matters.
sourceFindings.gap: There is no exposed admin reset/revoke-test-attempt endpoint. Retiring a bank does NOT invalidate previously approved durable attempt; durableCurrent evaluates project-scoped passed attempts independently of bank withdrawal. New bank alone therefore cannot guarantee a clean Shopper certification reset.
sourceFindings.safetyInvariant: If QA-only attempt cancellation/reset is required, implement source-proven target-scoped revocation with authenticated authorized admin, QA evidence predicate, reason, idempotency, provider ACK, audit/readback, and excluded eligibility/history projection, never silent hard deletion. Preserve legitimate historic carryover.

acceptanceRequired: Under Admin in DEV identify exact QA-only bank/project/period, withdraw it and verify provider receipt plus readback and disappearance from active selector after reload.
Create a distinct new QA bank in the same project/period with explicit QA status and no Shopper publication until review; verify remote ACK/readback and reload.
Ensure old bank is not selectable for new submissions; do not erase existing genuine certifications.
If a QA-only passed attempt exists, verify explicit scoped revocation/reset with audit and that Shopper eligibility is recomputed, or keep HOLD.
Verify 15-question test lifecycle through authenticated isolated QA shopper; independently reload history and confirm score/ACK; retain approved records unaffected.
nextAction: Implement/verify target-scoped QA-only attempt reset if truly needed; test safe bank retire/new-bank lifecycle only on explicitly identified disposable QA bank, with action-time browser deletion confirmation; never delete all four banks by assumption.
